where_you_are: Sir Phidipaldi is at the Golden Egg Tavern with its owner, Quinn. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are at the Clumsy Fox Tavern. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm on the edge of town, drinking with Gill on the porch.

immediate_intention.text: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are about to stage a fake ale shipment for Quinn's offer of 100 gold. Quinn will bring bottles, they will fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi will make a big show of delivering them to see what happens.
